messages:
elaine: Quick check proposing an 'ingress_hint' in rollout metadata to express a weak, control-plane-only preference for which ingress subgroup should serve a pinned model. Not a hard placement, just tie-breaker.

samir: Good idea. Need deterministic resolver semantics and backcompat rules: older controllers must ignore unknown fields.

matt: Validation: hint ids must be namespaced (prefix 'ingress-'), ascii lowercase/dash, max 32 chars. Reject unknown ids by default; allow an 'experimental' flag for tests.

elaine: Also add optional integer priority 0-10 (default 5) and a 'transition_minutes' to smooth changes. Resolver should only apply hint after capacity_ok().

nikki: Ops note: changing hints can spike KV cache misses. Require transition_minutes (default 10) and add a per-tenant throttle for hint updates. Dashboards: ingress-locality-hit-rate, kv-cache-miss, p95-latency.

ops-bot: schema-checker: pushed draft 'rollout-meta-v1.ingress-hint' to staging. Two legacy consumers failing validation.

samir: Resolver pseudocode: if not capacity_ok(candidate): continue; score=baseScore(candidate); if candidate.ingress_id==hint.id: score+=hint.priority*2; else if candidate.region==hint.region: score+=hint.priority; // tie-breaker only

matt: No auto-inference of hints. Hints must be explicit and auditable. Also log writes with unknown ids when experimental flag used.

elaine: Action items: matt -> schema + validator PR (reject unknown by default); samir -> implement scoring behind feature flag + unit tests; nikki -> runbook + dashboards + throttle; ops-bot -> re-run schema-checker after PRs. Keep opt-in until telemetry shows p95 wins. :thumbsup:
